newsitem.title: USA: Unionamerica Holdings Q4 net falls.
newsitem.headline: Unionamerica Holdings Q4 net falls.

text.p: (Dollars in thousands, except for per share data)
NOTES TO UNAUDITED STATEMENT OF OPERATIONS

(a) For ease of comparability, the unaudited pro-forma results of operations for the fourth quarter 1995 and year ended December 31, 1995 reflect the adjustments necessary to give effect to the additional investment income, reduction in financing cost, and increased goodwill amortization, and the
related taxation effects, arising as if the Initial Public Offering and reinsurance commutation had taken place an January 1, 1995.

(b) During the third quarter 1996 certain accruals made during 1995 for gross premiums written and reinsurance ceded, together with related policy acquisition costs and provisions for loss and loss adjustment expenses, were reversed as a result of revised estimates advised to the company by both clients and intermediaries. This had no material impact upon current earnings.
(c) Net investment income in the fourth quarter 1996 has
benefited from a non-recurring credit of $499,767. Non-recurring credits for the year total $2,242,767.

(d) Per share income (loss) figures are based upon the weighted average number of shares outstanding and the dilutive effect of share options held by management and the over-allotment options granted to the Underwriters in the Public Offering of December 1995, utilizing the treasury stock method and presented to give retroactive effect to the reverse stock split of 1 to 4.48 effective December 4, 1995. The weighted average number of ordinary shares and share equivalents outstanding was 8,796,559 and 5,771,350 for the three month periods ended December 31, 1996 and 1995 respectively, and 8,753,521 and 5,018,200 for the year ended December 31, 1996 and 1995 respectively.
(e) Net income excluding realized capital gains and losses net of taxes.
